Official sources & verification

Where these listings come from

Read on 2026-10-30. CIRC branches (UP, Rajasthan, MP, Bihar, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Uttarakhand) come from a July 2025 archive copy and have no address yet: open the CIRC list for each branch's contact sheet. SIRC lists Khammam and Nizamabad (Telangana) as "Soon", with no office details, so they are not shown. CA coaching covers the brands whose centre lists we could read; many local CA teachers and institutes are not listed yet. Fees are not listed: ICAI's own course fees are on the ICAI Board of Studies site, and coaching fees change every batch.

  1. ICAI Northern India Regional Council — Branches of NIRC (opens in a new tab) 25 branches (Haryana, Punjab, Chandigarh, Himachal Pradesh, J&K), address from each branch page, read 2026-10-30.
  2. ICAI Western India Regional Council — WIRC branches (opens in a new tab) 39 branches in Maharashtra, Gujarat and Goa with addresses, read 2026-10-30.
  3. ICAI Southern India Regional Council — statewise branches of SIRC (opens in a new tab) 46 branches with address and branch website, read 2026-10-30.
  4. ICAI Eastern India Regional Council — Branches of EIRC (opens in a new tab) 13 branches in West Bengal, Odisha and Assam, read 2026-10-30.
  5. ICAI Central India Regional Council — Branch contact details (opens in a new tab) 56 branches; the site refuses scripted reads, so the list was read from the Internet Archive copy of 20 July 2025. Each branch's contact sheet is linked there.
  6. Coaching brands' official centre locators and branch pages Each CA centre links to its own branch page or the brand's official list of centres, including ICAI branches' own coaching-class pages.
